question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **derailed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"derailed"** refers to something that has been thrown off course or disrupted. (पटरी से उतरना)

 
 
• **Example: **The project was derailed by unexpected budget cuts.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that witnessing someone with extraordinary talent stumble because they are missing a few fundamental abilities is one of life's biggest tragedies.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct option to fill in blank number 2 is **'derailed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **derailed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uplifted **(उत्साहित): Raise to a higher level or position.

 
 
• **Example:** The community was uplifted by the new development projects.
 
 
 
• **Damaged **(क्षतिग्रस्त): Harmed or impaired in some way.
 
 
• **Example: **The goods were damaged during transportation.
 
 
 
• **Channelised** (संचालित): Directed into a particular channel or path.
 
 
• **Example:** The river was channelised to prevent flooding.
